en.headline: CFS finds excessive bacteria in Shanghai zhajiang noodles from Kwai Chung shop
en.dek: A sample from a licensed snack food premises contained 95,000 Clostridium perfringens per gram, 8.5 times the limit; the shop was ordered to stop sale and dispose of the product.
body: The Centre for Food Safety announced that a sample of Shanghai zhajiang noodles taken from a licensed snack food premises in Kwai Chung was found to contain excessive levels of the pathogenic bacterium Clostridium perfringens.
Testing showed the sample contained 95,000 organisms per gram. Under the Microbiological Guidelines for Food, more than 10,000 per gram in ready-to-eat food is considered unsatisfactory.

The centre immediately investigated, took further samples and notified the premises. The operator stopped sale and disposed of the product as instructed, and received food safety and hygiene education. Staff were required to improve cooking processes and thoroughly clean and disinfect the premises.

zh.headline: 葵涌食肆上海炸醬麵樣本含過量產氣莢膜梭狀芽孢桿菌
zh.dek: 食安中心檢測發現每克含9.5萬個致病菌，超標8.5倍，食肆已按指示停售及棄置有關食品。
body: 食物安全中心公布，從葵涌一間持牌小食食肆抽取的上海炸醬麵樣本，被檢出含過量致病菌產氣莢膜梭狀芽孢桿菌。
檢測結果顯示樣本每克含9.5萬個細菌。根據《食品微生物含量指引》，每克即食食品含超過1萬個產氣莢膜梭狀芽孢桿菌即屬不滿意。
中心已即時派員調查、抽取食物樣本化驗，並知會食肆。該食肆已按指示停售和棄置有關食品，中心亦向負責人及員工提供食物安全和衞生教育，要求改善烹調流程及徹底清潔消毒。
